title: Adjective agreement
summary: Adjectives change with neuter singular, plural and definite noun phrases.

blocks.text: Adjectives change with neuter singular, plural and definite noun phrases.

Most adjectives add -t in the neuter singular indefinite (et stort møte). Adjectives ending in -ig, such as viktig, do not: et viktig møte. That is why the neuter example above looks unchanged. In definite phrases the adjective takes -e and the noun keeps its definite suffix: den viktige rapporten.
